name: nacl-skill
description: NaCl personal skills plugin - code generation and engineering workflows
skillInstructions:
NaCl-skill plugin for Kimi Code:

=== NATIVE SKILLS ===

- ddl-to-service: Generate MyBatis-Plus Mapper/Service/Controller from DDL or Domain class with Ruoyi conventions.
- mapstruct-converter-gen: Generate MapStruct Converter + DTO + VO from an Entity class. Supports both factory (Mappers.getMapper) and Spring DI (componentModel) styles.
- java-crud-stack-gen: Generate complete Java CRUD stack (Entity+Mapper+DTO+VO+Converter+Service+Domain+Controller) from DDL or Entity, with Domain aggregation layer and BaseController.

=== EXTERNAL SKILLS (bundled) ===

--- Superpowers (skills/external/superpowers/) ---
- using-superpowers: Master skill - establishes skill routing framework. Invoke FIRST when task starts.
- brainstorming: Structured brainstorming before any implementation.
- writing-plans: Write implementation plans (EnterPlanMode) before coding.
- systematic-debugging: Step-by-step debugging methodology for bugs.
- test-driven-development: TDD workflow - write tests before implementation.
- verification-before-completion: Verify work thoroughly before declaring done.
- dispatching-parallel-agents: Orchestrate parallel sub-agents efficiently.
- executing-plans: Execute pre-written plans safely with checkpoints.
- subagent-driven-development: Delegate work to subagents with clear contracts.
- finishing-a-development-branch: Complete feature branches with PR readiness.
- receiving-code-review: Process and respond to code review feedback.
- requesting-code-review: Conduct structured code reviews.
- using-git-worktrees: Use git worktrees for parallel development.
- writing-skills: Learn how to write new skill files.

--- Agent Skills for Context Engineering (skills/external/agent-skills/) ---
- context-fundamentals: Understand context mechanics in LLM agents.
- context-degradation: Detect and prevent context degradation (lost-in-middle, U-shaped attention).
- context-compression: Compression strategies for long session survival.
- context-optimization: Techniques to maximize signal-to-noise ratio.
- multi-agent-patterns: Architectures: supervisor, swarm, hierarchical.
- memory-systems: Memory design from scratchpad to temporal knowledge graphs.
- tool-design: Design agent tools that are robust and discoverable.
- filesystem-context: Use filesystem as external context layer.
- hosted-agents: Remote sandbox agent infrastructure patterns.
- long-horizon-prompting: Launch prompt design for autonomous agents.
- latent-briefing: KV memory sharing between orchestrator and workers.
- evaluation: Build deterministic evaluation frameworks.
- advanced-evaluation: Model judges, pairwise comparison, bias mitigation.
- harness-engineering: Operating loops around agents for reliability.
- self-improvement-loops: Meta-harness and recursive self-improvement.
- project-development: LLM-assisted project development lifecycle.
- bdi-mental-states: Belief-Desire-Intention agent modeling.

--- SuperClaude Framework (skills/external/superclaude/) ---
- confidence-check: Pre-implementation confidence assessment (>=90% required).
- brainstorm: Structured brainstorming.
- deep-research: Deep research and investigation workflows.
- pm: Project management methodology.
- token-efficiency: Reduce token waste and improve cost.
- troubleshoot: Systematic troubleshooting.

=== INTEGRATION RULES ===

1. Process skills come first — set approach, then implement.
   Example: "Build X" → brainstorming → writing-plans → [implementation skill]
   Example: "Fix bug" → systematic-debugging → [domain skill]

2. confidence-check (SuperClaude): Use BEFORE any implementation to verify >=90% readiness.

3. context-* skills: Use when managing long context, multi-agent systems, or optimizing agent behavior.

4. Superpowers skills: Use for daily engineering workflow — planning, coding, debugging, reviewing.
